actors.description: Lower body only, left of frame in the first view: black shorts, white low-top sneakers, small dark tattoo on the outer ankle; standing beside a teed golf ball in a low ground-level view.
Single lower leg and foot, center of the second view: black-and-white Nike sneaker with black ankle sock; positioned at a ball on a tee (ball stamped '3') in a low ground-level view.
Full-figure male golfer, center-left of the third view: white sleeveless tank top, khaki cargo shorts, white sneakers, dark hair; holding a driver on an open palm-lined fairway.
Lower body from behind/side in the fourth view: khaki shorts, white sneakers with tan/gum soles; standing over a teed ball (orange tee) next to a green driving-range mat.
Background bystander, upper-right of the second view: blue jeans and brown boots, legs only, standing near chairs and a bin.

shots.storyline: The clip is a montage of four golf driving views on a tropical course (dense green treeline, palms, a white yardage sign and utility pole in the first view; chairs, a bin and a bystander in the second; a wide fairway with a distant green mound in the third; a green range mat in the fourth), carrying a persistent 'DIEGO GARCIA' watermark whose pink/magenta highlight sweeps letter-by-letter across the text (roughly 2.2–3.7 s). View 1 (0.0–1.67 s): at grass level, P01's legs stand left of a teed ball; a dark motion-blurred club head flashes low between the legs and the ball at 0.0 s while the ball remains on the tee through 0.8 s (non-contact pass); the ball is gone by 0.9 s (bare tee stub) with no club framed, i.e. the strike itself is off-camera; from about 1.0–1.67 s the rear foot lifts with the sole facing camera and the planted foot bears weight, a held lower-body finish/weight-shift (a slight lateral shift of the planted foot leaves a step as an alternative reading). View 2 (1.7–3.44 s): after a cut, P02's Nike-shod foot stands behind a ball marked '3' with a driver head grounded beside it at 1.7 s; the head blurs moving toward frame-right at 1.8 s and exits the right edge at 1.9 s while the ball stays teed (no contact); the ball remains on the tee through 2.9 s and is gone by 3.0 s with no club framed; 3.0–3.44 s the Nike foot pivots/rotates and a second foot/leg enters at the right edge (stance change/repositioning). P05's jeans and boots stand in the upper-right background throughout. View 3 (3.47–4.40 s): a wide shot shows P03 at address over a teed ball (orange tee) with two spare balls on the grass to the right; the backswing is not captured in the sampled frames; at ~3.77 s the shaft/head blurs down through the hitting zone and the teed ball is no longer visible by 3.87 s; P03 then rotates into a held finish with arms wrapped across the chest and the club over his left shoulder through 4.40 s. View 4 (4.44–5.17 s): a final cut returns to a low rear view of P04's legs over a teed ball beside the green mat; the ball is on the tee at 4.53 s and gone by 4.63 s with the club never framed; P04 holds a weight-shifted finish with the rear heel raised (gum sole visible) until the clip ends, and a golf bag/tripod edges into the left frame late (from ~4.94 s).

visible_text.appearance: bold white sans-serif with thin black outline, lower-right quadrant; an animated pink/magenta highlight sweeps sequentially across the letters (approximately 2.2–3.7 s, timing approximate); present in every frame of all four views.

actions.evidence: A dark motion-blurred club head appears low near the teed ball at 0.0 s, but the ball is still on the tee at 0.1–0.8 s, so this is a non-contact pass; the club is not visible in any later frame of this view.
actions.detail: Tail end or fragment of a practice swing/whiff captured right at the clip start (boundary cropped); body essentially static; the single blurred frame does not establish movement direction or phase (downswing vs follow-through indeterminate).

actions.evidence: Ball present on the tee at 0.8008 s and absent (bare tee stub only) at 0.9009 s; no club or swing arc is framed in between.
actions.detail: The ball leaves the tee between sampled frames with the actual stroke off-camera; contact not directly visible.

actions.evidence: From ~1.0 s the rear foot lifts with the sole facing the camera while the tattooed-ankle foot stays planted bearing weight, held through 1.67 s; consistent with a lower-body finish after the off-camera strike; the club is never framed.
actions.detail: Held weight-shifted finish pose (rear heel raised), not walking — the lifted foot stays static for ~0.6 s; a slight leftward shift of the planted foot between 0.8 and 1.0 s leaves a step as an alternative reading (see uncertainties).

actions.evidence: Driver head grounded beside the teed ball '3' at 1.7017 s, blurs moving toward frame-right at 1.8018 s, and exits the right edge at 1.9019 s while the ball remains on the tee through 2.9 s.
actions.detail: Non-contact club sweep past the ball (whiff/practice pass); because the ball stays teed, no strike occurred; with the target direction unknown from this low angle, the pass could equally read as the start of a backswing moving away from address — phase indeterminate.

actions.evidence: Ball on the tee through 2.9029 s, gone by 3.003 s; no club is framed at the moment of departure.
actions.detail: The ball leaves the tee between frames; the strike (or removal) is off-camera and not directly visible.

actions.evidence: The Nike-shod foot pivots/rotates (toe turning toward frame-left) and a second foot/leg enters at the right edge from ~3.0–3.2 s; no club visible.
actions.detail: Stance change/repositioning after the ball departs; without a framed club this cannot be confirmed as a swing finish.

actions.evidence: From address (3.47–3.67 s, club grounded behind the teed ball) the shaft and head blur downward through the hitting zone at ~3.77 s, and the teed ball is no longer visible by 3.87 s (spare balls to the right remain).
actions.detail: Downswing into impact on an open fairway; the backswing itself is not captured in the sampled frames (gap between 3.67 and 3.77 s); contact inferred from ball departure and club blur, not directly seen.

actions.evidence: Hands rise past the waist at 3.87–3.97 s, arms wrap across the chest and the club finishes over the left shoulder by 4.07–4.27 s, held through 4.37–4.40 s with the torso rotated toward the target line.
actions.detail: Full upper-body follow-through into a held finish pose after the drive; gaze follows the ball downrange.

actions.evidence: Ball on the tee (orange tee) at 4.4378–4.5379 s and gone by 4.6380 s; the club is never inside the low frame.
actions.detail: Strike occurs between frames with the club not visible; contact inferred only from ball departure and the simultaneous onset of weight transfer.

actions.evidence: Rear (left) heel lifts off the grass showing the gum sole from ~4.74 s, weight settles on the front foot, and the stance is held through 5.17 s; a golf bag/tripod enters the left edge from ~4.94 s.
actions.detail: Lower-body follow-through/finish after the off-camera drive, viewed from behind at grass level; the club remains out of frame throughout.

uncertainties: Identities are not linked across the internal camera cuts (1.7017 s, 3.470133 s, 4.437767 s); P01–P04 may or may not be the same person.

In the first view the 0.0 s club-head blur coexists with a still-teed ball, so whether it is a whiff, a practice-swing fragment, or a mis-ordered boundary frame cannot be resolved; the actual strike that removes the ball by 0.9 s is off-camera.
In the first view, the held rear-heel-raised posture from ~1.0–1.67 s is read as a finish, but the slight lateral shift of the planted foot leaves open that the golfer is stepping/repositioning.

In the second view the driver sweeps past the ball at 1.7–1.9 s while the ball stays teed, so no contact occurred during that pass; the phase (whiffed downswing vs backswing start) is indeterminate because the target direction is not established from the low angle, and the ball's later disappearance (2.9–3.0 s) is not framed.

In the third view the backswing is not captured in the sampled frames (address at 3.67 s, blurred club at 3.77 s), so its timing is unknown; impact is inferred from the club blur and ball departure rather than directly seen.
In the fourth view the club is never in frame, so the downswing is inferred only from the ball leaving the tee and the rear-heel lift.
Exact frames of ball departure fall between sampled frames in several segments (0.8–0.9 s, 2.9–3.0 s, 4.5–4.6 s).
The letter-by-letter pink highlight sweep on the watermark is approximate (roughly 2.2–3.7 s).
